data: Region-localized candidates from all 204 folio-captioned views, with explicit missing/irregular subsets. Only training views learn family templates.
input_rule: Image masks and native geometry only; no conventional transcription identities, hand/Currier labels or positional-assay outputs.
image_features: Aspect-preserving 48 by 48 ink samples; PCA learned on training instances only. Native aspect, height, upper/lower extent, raster topology and connector/repetition measures remain explicit.
selection_rule: Compare validation template reconstruction, recurrence across training folios, held-out nearest-template residual and description length. Do not choose a family count to maximize any historical positional effect.
abstention_rule: Retain low-quality and outlying instances as unresolved, with alternate nearest families. Empty/failed extraction is a coverage failure, not a blank manuscript page.
recurrence_rule: A recurring family requires occurrences on at least three distinct training folio components; report weaker families separately.
height_tests: Compare continuous height/upper-extent distributions and mixtures. Height ratios use provisional local body estimates; measurement uncertainty and threshold sensitivity must be shown.
frame_tests: A long near-horizontal ink run is a candidate connector. Compare outer-structure similarity with varying middle/upper components and matched random masks; retain indivisible and decomposed models. A connector proxy is not proof of a reusable frame.
repetition_tests: Column ridges and recurring near-parallel traces are geometric proxies; compare whole runs versus disconnected fragments, with threshold/repair alternatives.
pen_lift_tests: Positive evidence requires source-visible separation or stroke interaction beyond threshold-induced fragmentation. Otherwise unresolved.
holdout: Calibration folios excluded from formal validation. Family learning uses train; model choice uses validation; final evaluation uses test without refit. Caption grouping does not establish complete bifolio independence.
freeze_gate: A segmentation snapshot must include hashes, all competing boundaries, unresolved identities, coverage exclusions and source-quality failures. No crosswalk before that snapshot; do not describe failed validation as a recovered script alphabet.
assay_position_rule: Ordinal group rank, native pixel x, normalized line-box pixel x, and arc position are distinct. Curved paths cannot enter horizontal x assays silently.
